release_notes: Ban 0.0.25: don not cac loi an (khong hien thong bao) — (1) bam Dong bo lan hai khi lan dau dang chay khong con lam app tat, hien thong bao 'Mot lan dong bo dang chay'; (2) luong tai tu dong va luong tra cuu to khai co bat exception: truoc day loi lam luong chet im lang nen giao dien dung mai o trang thai 'dang chay'; (3) them bo kiem tra tu dong (AST) chan viec tao hop thoai/widget trong luong nen va bat buoc moi luong nen phai bat exception, de loi nay khong tai dien.
